build_parser_base: build a ParserBase instance to configure CSV parsing options like parse_dates, index_col, and na_values
test_validate_usecols: test the _validate_usecols_arg function to verify usecols parameter contains all integers, strings, or a callable
refactor_infer_types: refactor the _infer_types method to convert object arrays to numeric, boolean, or nullable extension arrays
summarize_date_converter: summarize the date_converter function that converts date columns to datetime arrays with dayfirst and format support
run_clean_index_names: run the _clean_index_names method to extract index column names and remove them from the column list
